namespace.description: Apple App Attest verification controls for the iOS app.

fields.description: Enable Apple App Attest verification endpoints.
fields.name: enabled

fields.description: Require a verified App Attest assertion to bypass Turnstile on gated endpoints. When false, attestation is accepted but not required.
fields.name: require_attestation_for_bypass

fields.description: Accept attestations created in the DCAppAttestService development environment (debug/TestFlight builds). Disable in production.
fields.name: allow_development_attestation

fields.description: Per-request ECDSA signing mode for attested iOS devices. 'off' = disabled; 'observe' = verify and log failures but do not block; 'enforce' = reject requests with invalid or missing signatures.
fields.name: request_signing_mode

fields.description: Allow native sessions without a registered App Attest key to mint member MCP tokens. A registered key always requires a valid assertion.
fields.name: allow_unattested_native_mcp_mint

namespace.label: App Attestation
